changelog:
### New Features
- Profile picture upload (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP up to 2MB)
- Account tab: My Profile, Change Password, Reset Password

### Bug Fixes
- Avatar not persisting on live servers (direct DB writes bypass Redis/Memcached cache)
- Profile save not persisting — explicit meta writes
- Encoding fix: garbled ellipsis in Generating... text (tmpmp-address)
- Mobile responsive: account cards stack on small screens
